concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-auth-multi-currency-node]] - closed-beta Node.js route for adding and listing presentment currencies for connected merchants who signed up through Braintree Auth, with access-token, payment-method support and Amex-specific qualifications
warnings: Keep Braintree Auth distinct from generic payment-transaction authorization and ordinary merchant-owned credentials.
Preserve the closed-beta, new-signup platform and Braintree-Auth-created merchant-account conditions.
Do not infer current product availability, platform or merchant eligibility, account enablement, or support for a particular currency.
Keep the Amex-specific other-card success and later validation-error statement visible beside the page's unreconciled general all-payment-method rule.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-auth-multi-currency-node]] - connected-merchant presentment-currency creation and listing route limited to Braintree Auth signups, with all-payment-method support conditions and a preserved Amex-specific qualification
warnings: Do not generalize this Braintree Auth route to merchants who connect existing non-OAuth Braintree accounts.
Treat currency creation and account listing as separate actions and leave exact Node.js example details in the source raw.
Preserve the internal tension between the general no-new-account outcome and the Amex-specific other-card success outcome.
Do not treat the four named Amex currencies as a complete or currently verified provider-wide currency catalog.
